exit: Some(0)
--- stdout ---
Usage: retopo --input <file|dir> --output <file|dir> [options]

Required:
  -i, --input <file|dir>   Input mesh (.obj or .glb) or a directory
                           of meshes (batch mode, non-recursive)
  -o, --output <path>      Output: mesh file for one input, directory
                           for batch or --lods (created if missing)

Sizing:
  --target-quads <count>   Target quad count (default: 50000)
  --lods <q0,q1,...>       Emit a full LOD chain in one run, e.g.
                           --lods 10000,5000,2000 writes
                           <stem>_lod0.<ext>, <stem>_lod1.<ext>, ...
                           next to --output (overrides --target-quads)

Quality:
  --edge-scaling <factor>  Average edge length vs target size
                           (default: 1.0, range 1.0-4.0)
  --sharp-edge <degrees>   Creases at/above this dihedral angle stay
                           sharp (default: 90.0, range 30-180)
  --smooth-normal <degrees>  Blend shading normals across edges below
                           this angle (default: 0.0 = off, range 0-180)
  --adaptivity <value>     0 = uniform quads, 1 = follow curvature
                           (default: 1.0, range 0-1)
  --anisotropy <value>     0 = square quads, 1 = stretch along
                           curvature (default: 1.0, range 0-1)
  --model-type <organic|hardsurface>
                           Shape hint (default: organic)
  --symmetry <off|auto|x|y|z>  Mirror the output across a plane
                           (default: off; auto detects it)

Output:
  -q, --quiet              Only warnings, errors, and the report
  --verbose                Full phase timings + engine diagnostics
                           on stderr (default shows progress only)
  --uvs [on|off]           Also write remeshed UVs (default: off;
                           bare --uvs means on)
  --report <report.txt>    Write a stats report file as well

Constraints (single-file and --lods runs only):
  --guides <file>          Steer quad flow along polylines
                           (eye/mouth loops). File: one 'x y z'
                           point per line, blank lines separate
                           polylines, '#' starts a comment
  --features <file>        Keep crisp edges along polylines. Same
                           file format as --guides
  --density <file>         Local density multipliers, one per input
                           vertex in OBJ v-line order (1.0 =
                           unchanged). '#' starts a comment
  --dipoles <off|auto>     Extraordinary verts on sharp --density
                           steps (default: auto)

Expert:
  --dipole-every <count>   Override: place every k-th dipole ring
                           (default: 0 = automatic)
  --dipole-ratio <value>   Override: minimum density-step sharpness
                           for dipole insertion (default: 0 =
                           automatic 1.5)
  -h, --help               Show this help (--help --all adds
                           expert flag detail)
  -v, --version            Show version

Examples:
  retopo -i dragon.obj -o dragon_remeshed.obj
  retopo -i dragon.obj -o dragon_5k.obj --target-quads 5000
  retopo -i scans/ -o remeshed/ --lods 10000,5000,2000
  retopo -i cad.obj -o cad.obj --model-type hardsurface \
      --sharp-edge 30 --report cad_stats.txt

Getting more:
  Full guide: README.md. Every flag also accepts --flag=value.
  stdout carries only results (report block, LOD/FILE rung
  lines); progress, warnings, and errors go to stderr.

Expert flag detail:
  --dipole-every <count>   Dipole dose stride override: place
                           every k-th ring candidate. Higher k =
                           fewer rings along density steps.
                           (default: 0 = auto line-ending estimate)
  --dipole-ratio <value>   Dipole step-sharpness override: minimum
                           density-step sharpness for dipole
                           insertion. Higher ratio = fewer, sharper
                           steps qualify. (default: 0 = auto 1.5)

--- stderr ---
